title: Desperate Formation
next_chapter_hook: An aged laughter echoed from the depths of the formation, announcing the official start of the first trial.

text.content: The setting sun hung like blood, dyeing the ancient ruins of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain in an ominous crimson. Chen Ji stood before the weathered stone gate, his brow slightly furrowed. The runes on the stone gate were far older than he had anticipated—that sense of vicissitude couldn't have accumulated over merely a few centuries; it seemed more like... crossing ten thousand years of time.

dialogue.content: Are you certain we can enter here?

text.content:
Chen Ji glanced sideways at the black-robed woman beside him. Ye Qing, the Holy Sect's saintess of the Demonic Path, now appeared as an ordinary wandering cultivator, her alluring features concealed by secret techniques to look unremarkable. Only those eyes still couldn't hide the coldness in her bones.

"I'm certain." His voice was calm to the point of coldness. "Three months ago, I saw a fragmentary record in the scripture library. During ancient times, a great power left an inheritance here, and the runes on the stone gate match the patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment."

dialogue.content: Tianji Record... you really dare to take on anything for yourself.

text.content:
Ye Qing's tone carried a hint of scrutiny. Chen Ji had been cooperating with her for months, but she still couldn't fully trust this man who appeared like a废物 yet was as deep as an abyss. After all, his ability to endure over a decade as a servant in Tianqing Sect was itself a dangerous signal.

"Let's go." Chen Ji offered no explanation, simply raising his hand to press his palm against the stone gate.

In an instant, the runes blazed to life. Not gradually activating, but erupting like a slumbering beast awakened by blood!

"Not good!" Ye Qing cried out.

The stone gate did not open as they had anticipated. Instead, the runes spread from the gate, crawling across the ground beneath their feet like living entities—within a radius of ten zhang, the runes interwove into an airtight net of death.

dialogue.content: This is... a Lethal Trap formation!

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze hardened. He felt the ground beneath his feet radiating intense heat, the runes frantically absorbing spiritual energy from heaven and earth, transforming it into some terrifying strangling force.

"Standard Lethal Trap for Golden Core stage cultivators." His voice grew heavy. "A formation specifically designed against Golden Core stage cultivators."

Ye Qing's expression also changed. She was indeed at Nascent Soul stage cultivation, but trapped in this confined space, the formation's power would forcibly suppress her combat ability to the Golden Core level.

The runes began to contract.

This was not simple spatial compression, but a prelude to strangulation. The edges of the runes rose upward, forming sharp blade edges. A suffocating pressure filled the air—that was the formation telling them:

The first trial is about to begin.

Chen Ji's brow center jumped violently.

At an angle Ye Qing couldn't see, the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest suddenly emitted a faint warmth. Not the first, second, or third page—it was the fourth page, which had never shown any response before!

Chen Ji's heart surged, but his expression revealed nothing.

The fourth page... Could this formation have some connection to the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content: Hey, have you gone stupid from fear? Hurry up and think of something!

text.content:
Ye Qing's voice broke Chen Ji's thoughts. He looked up at this woman and saw in her eyes, besides anxiety, a barely concealed wariness.

She was suspicious of him.

After all, everything was too coincidental. He was the one who led the way, he was the one who confirmed there was an inheritance here, and now, they just happened to be trapped at the first trial.

If she were an outsider, she would also suspect this was an elaborately designed trap.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing was clearly suspicious of him, and now needed to respond to resolve this trust crisis

choices.description: Honestly admit he also didn't know triggering the Lethal Trap would happen, use a harmless posture to reduce her wariness
choices.risk_hint: She might instead think you're putting on an act

dialogue.content: I didn't know it would be like this either.

text.content: Chen Ji's tone was very candid, even carrying a hint of helplessness. "If this were a trap, would I have any reason to drag myself into it?"

dialogue.content: ...That does make sense.

choices.text: Take the initiative to confront and question
choices.description: Directly point out her suspicions are baseless, use momentum to overwhelm her suspicion
choices.risk_hint: She's at the Nascent Soul stage, once provoked it won't end well

dialogue.content: Are you doubting me?

text.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned soft, but the chill made Ye Qing unconsciously step back half a pace. 'Since we started cooperating, if I wanted to harm you, there were plenty of opportunities.'

dialogue.content: ...Hmph.

choices.description: Not responding to her suspicion directly, but drawing attention to solving the formation itself
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining mystique while advancing the mission
choices.risk_hint: She might have been holding onto this matter all along

dialogue.content: She can doubt me, but first let's survive this.

text.content: Chen Ji stopped looking at her and crouched down to carefully observe the rune patterns. He'd anticipated Ye Qing's suspicion long ago—the woman was notoriously suspicious, but now wasn't the time for explanations.

dialogue.content: ...You're really infuriating.

text.content:
The formation's contraction continued accelerating after a brief pause.

Chen Ji scanned his surroundings—the 81 runes formed a complete trapped-kill formation node. An ordinary Golden Core cultivator trapped here could last at most the time it takes to burn a stick of incense.

But he was no ordinary cultivator.

The warmth from the fourth page of the Tianji Record grew increasingly intense, as if something was awakening. Chen Ji's heart stirred as he attempted to probe that warmth with his consciousness.

A blurred message flooded his mind.

Not a complete premonition, but a fragmented image—the rune formation had nodes at eight cardinal and intercardinal directions. Disrupting any one of them would throw the entire formation into brief chaos.

But the image vanished in an instant, and the fourth page of the Tianji Record fell silent again.

Chen Ji closed his eyes briefly. Five Heavenly Fate points. That brief glimpse had cost him five precious Heavenly Fate points.

dialogue.content: What are you spacing out for! The formation is about to fully contract!

text.content:
There was already a hint of panic in Ye Qing's voice. Though her cultivation was above the formation's designed ceiling, trapped within its Golden Core combat constraints, she couldn't forcefully break through.

Chen Ji opened his eyes and stood up.

'East, south, west, north, southeast, northeast, southwest, northwest—eight directions, each with a node.' he said quickly. 'You attack northeast, I'll take southwest. Strike simultaneously to disrupt the nodes.'

Ye Qing froze. 'How do you know?'

'What's with all the questions?' Chen Ji was already moving,

choice.prompt: Chen Ji revealed the key to breaking the formation, and Ye Qing's suspicion grew again, but time was running out and they had to act immediately

choices.description: Choose to trust Chen Ji's judgment, both strike simultaneously to destroy the nodes
choices.visible_cost: If the intelligence is wrong, they'll fall into an even greater crisis
choices.visible_reward: Successfully took the first step to break the formation
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing retained a sliver of vigilance

dialogue.content: Fine!

text.content: Without hesitation, Ye Qing's figure flashed and she was already at the northeast position. Her fingers condensed a sharp demonic qi, stabbing directly at that node. At the same moment, Chen Ji struck—an unremarkable sword qi shot toward the southwest node. The two attacks struck almost simultaneously—the rune formation shuddered violently!

choices.text: Demand Chen Ji to strike first
choices.description: Let Chen Ji prove he wasn't lying, let him destroy the node first to verify the intelligence's authenticity

dialogue.content: You strike first, I'll cover you.

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at her, and that gaze made Ye Qing inexplicably feel a pang of guilt. But he only nodded lightly, darting alone toward the southwest node. Sword qi tore through the air, striking with precision—the node shattered on impact!

dialogue.content: ...Impressive technique.

text.content: The moment the node shattered, the rune formation abruptly stagnated. The converging rune blade lights paused for about three breaths, then began twisting even more frantically—but not converging, rather becoming chaotic! 'Success!' A flash of joy appeared in Ye Qing's eyes. Yet Chen Ji's brow furrowed even deeper. Something was wrong. If destroying the node was correct, the entire formation should have completely collapsed. But now, it was only in chaos, not dissipating.

Just then, a voice echoed from the depths of the formation. That voice was aged and distant, as if having traversed countless ages, carrying a commanding gaze of scrutiny: 'Not bad, finding the node's flaw within one incense stick's time shows some insight.' Ye Qing's face instantly turned ashen. This voice—she had never felt such overwhelming pressure, not even from the master of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. 'But—' the voice continued, with a hint of mockery, 'Did you think the first trial had only this single layer?'

Before the words finished, the rune formation transformed dramatically once more! The chaotic runes did not dissipate but began rearranging and recombining. The original eighty-one runes suddenly became three hundred sixty-five—a year's worth of days! Each rune began emanating different energies: some scorching fire attribute, some biting ice attribute, some sharp metal attribute... This was a composite formation. It had absorbed their attacks and evolved itself!

dialogue.content: This... how is this possible!

text.content: Ye Qing's voice trembled. Three hundred sixty-five runes, each containing the full force of a Golden Core cultivator's strike. This meant that in its activated state, the formation could release three hundred sixty-five Golden Core-level attacks in an instant! Even a Nascent Soul cultivator would fare poorly against such attack density. Let alone they were now suppressed to Golden Core combat levels! Chen Ji's hand unconsciously pressed against his chest. The fourth page of the Tianji Record radiated warmth again, seemingly urging him to foresee something. But he had already consumed five Heavenly Fate points, and using it again would cost ten. His Heavenly Fate was nearly depleted.

choice.prompt: Composite formation activated, crisis escalating. Chen Ji faces a choice: use the Tianji Record to foresee the solution, or find another way?

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to foresee
choices.description: Consume ten Heavenly Fate points to completely foresee the method to break the composite formation
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is enormous, later may fall into even greater danger

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record at his chest. The fourth page suddenly blazed with blinding light, and that familiar power surged into his mind—a complete vision materialized before him: the composite formation's core lies at the central Qian position, and the key to breaking it is not destroying nodes, but rather...

dialogue.content: I see it. The Qian position is the core. As long as someone holds off the surrounding rune attacks, another person can directly seize the Qian position, and the formation will surely break.
You... what means did you use?

choices.description: Do not consume Heavenly Fate points, rely on one's own strategy and observation to find the flaw
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate and temper myself
choices.risk_hint: Time is pressing; observation may come too late

text.content: Chen Ji did not activate the Tianji Record. His gaze swept rapidly across the rearranged runes as his mind spun swiftly. Three hundred sixty-five runes, corresponding to three hundred sixty-five days... If this formation is arranged according to celestial patterns, the core must be at—

dialogue.content: Qian position. Fifteen degrees east of due north.
How do you know?

text.content: Celestial formations are inseparable from the Eight Trigrams positions. Qian represents heaven, its corresponding direction is exactly fifteen degrees east of north. Chen Ji did not explain, merely raising his hand to point at that location. 'The core is there.'

dialogue.content: ...Alright, I'll trust you this once.

choices.text: Let Ye Qing scout ahead first
choices.description: Use rhetoric to guide Ye Qing into testing the formation's true power, thereby observing its weaknesses
choices.visible_cost: May damage the relationship between the two
choices.visible_reward: Do not consume Heavenly Fate, while gaining first-hand intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by Ye Qing, consequences will be severe

dialogue.content: Can your demonic path fog conceal spiritual signatures?
...You want me to scout ahead?

text.content: Chen Ji did not deny. 'Your demonic path fog can disrupt the formation's perception. If you can approach and observe the core position, it's much safer than me acting rashly.'

dialogue.content: So you really intend to use me as a blade.

text.content:
In the end, Ye Qing moved.

Not because she trusted Chen Ji, but because she trusted this formation's hidden master even less. The owner of that aged voice gave her an extremely dangerous feeling, more terrifying than any demonic path great cultivator she had ever known.

If she had to choose between Chen Ji and that unknown existence, she would rather temporarily place her faith in the former.

The demonic path fog spread silently as Ye Qing's form gradually became illusory and translucent, like a ghost融入黑暗的幽灵. She moved silently toward the Qian position, yet those three hundred sixty-five runes seemed to treat her as if she did not exist.

Chen Ji suppressed his spiritual presence in place, while staring intently at Ye Qing's movements. His left hand had secretly gathered power, ready to provide support the moment she was exposed.

Time passed by the second.

Ye Qing had approached to within three zhang of the core. Through gaps in the demonic path fog, Chen Ji saw her gesturing something to him—

The core truly was at the Qian position. And there, there was an extremely faint crack!

dialogue.content: (Gesturing: Crack. Need simultaneous attacks from inside and outside.)

text.content:
Chen Ji understood immediately. He took out an ordinary talisman from his怀— it was basic supplies he received monthly as a Servant Disciple, meant for驱寒的最低级符箓. But now in his hands, it became the key to breaking the局.

He crushed the talisman, transforming it into a faint spiritual light that shot toward the formation's edge.

'Boom!'

The talisman's spiritual energy triggered several runes at the edge, which immediately turned in that direction to绞杀— and in that instant, the crack at the Qian position core widened slightly!

'Now!' Chen Ji shouted in a low voice.

Ye Qing acted without hesitation!

Her form burst from the fog, one palm striking that crack. The demonic path fog completely erupted at this moment, transforming into a beam of pitch-black light that shot straight into the formation's core!

'Crack—'

A crisp sound. That crack suddenly expanded, spreading in all directions like a shattered mirror. Immediately, the entire compound formation began剧烈颤抖, and the three hundred sixty-five runes simultaneously emitted a piercing wail!

'Interesting.' That aged voice rang out again, this time carrying a genuine note of interest. 'You have successfully passed the advanced stage of the first trial.'

Advanced stage?

Chen Ji and Ye Qing both felt a chill in their hearts. They had thought breaking the formation meant passing the trial, only to discover this was merely the beginning.

As the runes dissipated, a more expansive underground space appeared before them. The surrounding walls were covered with dense ancient text, emanating a faint ghostly glow. And at the very center of the space, a虚幻的人影 sat cross-legged.

It was an elderly man's illusion.

He had silvery white hair, an ancient countenance, wearing a namelessDaoist robe from some unknown era. But what chilled hearts most were those eyes— even as merely an illusion, those eyes seemed able to pierce through time and fate, to see through all worldly illusions.

dialogue.content: (This aura...)

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart suddenly leaped.

Not from fear, but because— this illusion's aura had some indefinable connection with the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest. That feeling was like... the same origin.

The elderly man's illusion slowly opened his eyes. His turbid gaze swept over Ye Qing before finally fixing on Chen Ji.

'Finally arrived.' His voice carried a sigh of尘埃落定, 'The heir of the Tianji Record... I have waited for you for a very long time.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

dialogue.content: Tianji Record?!

text.content:
Ye Qing abruptly turned her head to look at Chen Ji, her eyes filled with disbelief.

She knew Chen Ji had secrets, knew he was connected to the Tianji Record, but she never expected that the true inheritor of the Tianji Record would actually be standing right in front of her! She had cooperated with the Demonic Holy Sect all this time precisely to find clues about the Tianji Record, and this clue—

Had actually been by her side all along!

Chen Ji paid no attention to Ye Qing's gaze. His attention was completely captured by the old man's phantom.

"Who are you?" he asked, his voice much calmer than he had expected, "What is your connection to the Tianji Record?"

The old man's phantom smiled faintly: "Who I am is not important. What matters is that—the fragmented Tianji Record on your body is finally beginning to awaken."

Chen Ji instinctively pressed his hand against his chest. The fourth page of the Tianji Record was indeed emitting a faint warmth, something he had never experienced before.

"The awakening of the fourth page requires a price." The old man's phantom continued, "The Heavenly Fate value you consumed just now has triggered its memories. Next, you will see some... things you may not want to see."

The moment his voice fell, the fourth page of the Tianji Record burst forth with a brilliant light!

Chen Ji felt his vision go black, followed by countless images flooding into his mind like a tide—

It was a grand scene.

Under the vast starry sky, countless cultivators knelt on the ground. And at the highest point, a blurred figure overlooked all living beings—that aura... was exactly the same as the old man's phantom at this moment.

"You've seen it." The old man's phantom voice echoed within the illusion, "The Tianji Record is no ordinary object. It was a heaven-defying artifact forged by a great being in ancient times, capable of窥探天机, of divining fate. But the price is—every time it's used, the user is gradually counteracted by fate."

Chen Ji saw more images.

He saw the inheritors of the Tianji Record through the ages, falling one after another. Some died in heavenly tribulation, some in pursuit, some in their own madness...

Not a single one met a good end.

The illusion suddenly dissolved.

Chen Ji found himself kneeling on the ground, his forehead covered in cold sweat. The Tianji Record fragment on his chest emitted waves of throbbing pain, as if reminding him that everything he had just seen was real.

"This is the truth of the Tianji Record." The old man's phantom voice became increasingly ethereal, "Your fate was destined the moment you obtained the Tianji Record."

Ye Qing stood在一旁, watching all of this, her expression complicated beyond measure.

Chen Ji slowly stood up. There was no fear in his eyes, only a calm that was terrifyingly cold.

"And then?" he asked, "Why are you telling me all this?"

The old man's phantom fell silent for a moment, then smiled.

"Indeed extraordinary." His voice carried a hint of admiration, "When others learned the truth, they either broke down or went mad. But you—actually still asking 'and then?'"

The phantom raised his finger pointing at Chen Ji's chest: "I offer you a choice. First, continue down this path. The Tianji Record will become more complete, your abilities will grow stronger, but fate's backlash will also become increasingly severe, until one day it completely devours you."

"Second—" his finger turned toward another direction, where a phantom door appeared, "Abandon the Tianji Record. I will send you away from here. You can become an ordinary person and live peacefully for the rest of your life."

Ye Qing held her breath. This choice—too heavy.

Chen Ji stared at the phantom door, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes.

To become an ordinary person.

For the Chen Ji of the past, this temptation might have truly existed. After all, he had endured as a废物 in the Tianqing Sect for so many years. If he could exchange it for a peaceful life...

But now, everything was different.

Chen Nian—his sister who had been missing for years, was still in the Holy Sect's hands. Heavenly Eye—that ultimate boss, was manipulating everything behind the scenes. Even if he abandoned the Tianji Record, would those who had pursued him let him go?

Moreover—

He looked at the faintly glowing Tianji Record fragment on his chest, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

dialogue.content: "I refuse."

text.content:
The old man's phantom seemed unsurprised: "Oh? Why?"

"Because I have no way out anymore." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, fate has been hunting me. If I give up, they won't spare me; if I fight, there might still be a sliver of hope."

He raised his head, staring directly into the phantom's eyes: "And—I have reasons why I must grow stronger."

Chen Nian's smile flashed through his mind. She was his only remaining kin in this world.

The old man's phantom gazed at Chen Ji for a long moment, then let out a long sigh.

"Very well. Since it's come to this, continue on your path then."

His form began to gradually fade, but his voice became increasingly clear: "The first trial, you have passed. There are still two more waiting for you."

"Remember—" the phantom left his final words before completely vanishing, "The more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the stronger fate's deadly backlash grows. When you gather all nine pages, that will be the day you face the Heavenly Eye."

"Heavenly Eye..." Chen Ji murmured the name, a cold glint flickering in his eyes.

The phantom completely vanished, and the underground space returned to silence.

Ye Qing finally couldn't help but speak: "Chen Ji, the Tianji Record on your body... what's going on?"

Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. He closed his eyes, feeling the warmth emanating from the fourth page on his chest. The fourth page of the Tianji Record had completely awakened, and his mind had gained much knowledge that originally didn't belong to him—about talismanic formations, about Tianji divination, about that ultimate boss, the Heavenly Eye.

"It's a long story." He opened his eyes and looked at Ye Qing, "But now isn't the time to explain."

He raised his hand pointing toward another door deep in the space: "There are still two trials waiting for us. Let's get out alive first, then talk about the rest.

Ye Qing fell silent.

She knew Chen Ji hadn't told her the whole truth. Given the weight of the Tianji Record, he could have told her nothing. But he didn't drive her away, nor did he eliminate her—this meant that before her value was completely exhausted, he still needed her as an ally.

This woman was perceptive, instantly seeing through many things.

But she also understood another thing: being able to reject the "ordinary life" option offered by the old man, choosing to continue down this road of nine deaths and one survival—这个男人's ambition and resolve were far more terrifying than she had imagined.

"The Tianji Record's inheritor..." she silently念道 in her heart, "How interesting."

At the same time, Chen Ji had already stepped toward that door. His back view in the dim light appeared particularly lonely, yet revealed an unshakeable determination.

Just as the two were about to step out of this space, a voice rang out once more.

This time it wasn't the old man's phantom voice, but a more aged, more eerie laughter:

"Hahaha... Interesting, interesting! The Tianji Record's inheritor actually still has the guts to continue walking?"

Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly stopped.

That laughter came from all directions, making it impossible to discern the direction. More eerily, he felt the first page of the Tianji Record on his chest—the page where Mo Xiansheng resided—suddenly emit a violent tremor.

"Mo Xiansheng?" Chen Ji低呼 in his heart.

A weak voice rang out in his mind: "Be careful... The master of this laughter... is not an existence of this epoch... He is..."

Before the words finished, the laughter suddenly stopped. Replacing it was a voice full of mockery:

"The Tianji Record's little guardian, you haven't completely died yet?"

Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly.

He knew Mo Xiansheng's origins were mysterious, knew that countless secrets lay hidden behind the Tianji Record, but he never expected—that within this ruins existed an entity capable of threatening Mo Xiansheng!

"Chen Ji." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time carrying unprecedented solemnity, "For the upcoming trials... I cannot give you too many hints. The master of this laughter is related to the ancient catastrophe."

"Ancient catastrophe..." Chen Ji's heart sank.

He had glimpsed fragments in the incomplete records in the scripture library. It was a disaster that occurred tens of thousands of years ago, sweeping across the entire cultivation world, countless sects were destroyed, great beings fell. And the cause of this catastrophe had always been a mystery.

Now it seemed, this mystery might be related to the Tianji Record.

"Don't stand there in a daze." Ye Qing's voice broke Chen Ji's thoughts, "Whatever's ahead, we still have to move forward."

Chen Ji glanced at her, then suddenly smiled.

"You're right." He stepped forward, "We've come this far. Can't possibly give up halfway."

The door slowly opened before them. Beyond it was a deep corridor, its walls covered with even more ancient runes, each rune emitting a chilling aura.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped into the corridor.

He didn't know what still awaited ahead. But he knew that from the moment he chose to continue walking, there was already no turning back.

Heavenly Eye? Fate's deadly backlash? Secrets of the ancient catastrophe?

Bring it on.

Deep within the corridor, laughter rang out once more.

This time, the laughter carried a genuine sense of anticipation:

"Very well, very well... Let's see just how far this generation's Tianji Record inheritor can go!"

Chen Ji's footsteps showed not the slightest hesitation.

His right hand had already quietly gripped the sword hilt hidden in his sleeve, while his left hand gently pressed against his chest—where the four pages of the Tianji Record glowed faintly, as if responding to this ancient ruins.

First trial, passed.

Second trial... about to begin.
